literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 估计该暴发谱系起源与首例报告病例之间的时间间隔,与未被检测到的本地传播时期一致,并揭示了被动监测在早期虫媒病毒暴发检测中的局限性。 [10.64898/2026.11.04.26367289]
宏结构域(MD)提供了机械稳定性,但在数十皮牛的力作用下会发生断裂。 [10.64898/2026.11.05.764274]
结果显示,基孔肯雅病毒后慢性疼痛与焦虑和抑郁症状的高患病率、功能受损以及生活质量下降密切相关。 [10.36692/v18n3-13r]

来源审查支持了547份来源定义的年度计数报告中的543份,包括226份明确的零值报告。训练单元均值的时间偏差低于经验贝叶斯方法(35,800.49 vs 75,242.16),但配对差异的−39,441.67具有一个95%单位自举区间,覆盖范围包括零(−113,569.18至1,552.40)。巴西和古巴占净差异的101.7%;排除它们则逆转了点排名。校准后的95%置信区间覆盖率为总体77/85(90.6%),在美洲地区为9/16(56.3%);更宽的置信区间使总体区间得分从309,178增加到378,773。 [10.2196/preprints.116458]
本研究指出,尽管两种疫苗(IXCHIQ ® 和 VIMKUNYA ®)已在部分国家获得批准,但目前尚无抗病毒药物疗法获批,支持性护理仍是临床管理的主要手段。 [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1954201]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。

key_findings_en: The interval between the estimated origin of the outbreak lineage and the first reported case was consistent with a period of undetected local transmission and exposed limitations in passive surveillance for early arboviral outbreak detection. [10.64898/2026.11.04.26367289]
The macrodomain (MD) provides mechanical stability, yet it fractures under tens of piconewtons of force. [10.64898/2026.11.05.764274]

Os resultados demonstraram que a dor crônica pós-chikungunya está consistentemente associada a maior prevalência de sintomas ansiosos e depressivos, comprometimento funcional e redução da qualidade de vida. [10.36692/v18n3-13r]
Source review supported 543 of 547 reports for the source-defined annual-count target, including 226 explicit zeros. [10.2196/preprints.116458]

The study identified that although two vaccines (IXCHIQ ® and VIMKUNYA ® ) have been authorized in selected countries, no antiviral therapy has been approved, and supportive care remains the mainstay of clinical management. [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1954201]

The interval between the estimated origin of the outbreak lineage and the first reported case was consistent with a period of undetected local transmission and exposed limitations in passive surveillance for early arboviral outbreak detection. The macrodomain (MD) provides mechanical stability, yet it fractures under tens of piconewtons of force. [10.64898/2026.11.05.764274]. key_findings_zh: 世卫组织发布了虫媒病毒疾病临床管理指南,包括基孔肯雅热、登革热、寨卡病毒和黄热病。 [news-83b6078a2dc5192d]
监测正在进行的 基孔肯雅病毒 疾病 暴发,自 2026 年初以来共报告了 271,223 例病例和 113 例相关死亡。 [news-d9a62165c461681d]
贾坎德邦政府发布了一项全州范围的建议,以启动预防措施并加强 监测,以遏制登革热和基孔肯雅热(蚊媒疾病)的传播。该建议由卫生、医学教育和家庭福利部发布。 [news-4fafe16a52555ae8]
瑞士提契诺州确诊 基孔肯雅热 病例,其中 4 人检测呈阳性。州医疗官员乔治·梅拉尼(Giorgio Merlani)呼吁对亚洲虎蚊采取预防措施,这种蚊子也会传播登革热。 [news-5d439a539a83f18d]
基孔肯雅热和登革热是由伊蚊传播的蚊媒病毒性疾病。这些疾病的特点是发烧、关节疼痛和其他症状。由于共享蚊子 媒介 和气候变化,同时出现的 暴发 正在上升。 [news-d1a31ca8002f9845]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: WHO launched guidelines for clinical management of arboviral diseases, including chikungunya, dengue, Zika, and yellow fever. [news-83b6078a2dc5192d]
Monitoring of ongoing chikungunya virus disease outbreaks, with a total of 271,223 cases and 113 associated deaths reported since the start of 2026. [news-d9a62165c461681d]

The Jharkhand government issued a statewide advisory to launch preventive measures and intensify surveillance to curb the spread of dengue and chikungunya, which are mosquito-borne diseases. The advisory was issued by the Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare. [news-4fafe16a52555ae8]

Chikungunya fever cases were confirmed in Ticino, Switzerland, with four individuals testing positive. The cantonal medical officer, Giorgio Merlani, is calling for preventive measures against the Asian tiger mosquito, which also transmits dengue fever. [news-5d439a539a83f18d]

Chikungunya and Dengue are mosquito-borne viral diseases transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. The diseases are characterized by fever, joint pain, and other symptoms. Coinciding outbreaks are rising due to shared mosquito vectors and climate change. [news-d1a31ca8002f9845]

papers.title: Genomic epidemiology reconstructs the pre-detection transmission and establishment of chikungunya virus in Guangdong, China
papers.abstract: In 2025, a chikungunya outbreak in southern China resulted in more than 25,000 confirmed cases, but its origins and transmission history remain unresolved. As part of the public health investigation, we generated 1,264 near-complete chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomes from Guangdong Province and integrated genomic, epidemiological, entomological, and human mobility data to reconstruct the emergence and spread of this outbreak. Our analyses traced the outbreak to a single dominant introduction of a Reunion-associated East/Central/South African (ECSA) virus lineage and dated the origin of the sampled Guangdong outbreak lineage from late April to early May 2025. The interval between the estimated origin of the outbreak lineage and the first reported case was consistent with a period of undetected local transmission and exposed limitations in passive surveillance for early arboviral outbreak detection. Spatiotemporal reconstruction showed two distinct epidemic waves with contrasting transmission dynamics. The Foshan wave involved frequent medium- to long-distance viral movement, while the Jiangmen wave remained relatively localized. Together, these findings reconstruct the early establishment and spatially heterogeneous spread of the largest documented CHIKV epidemic in southern China to date and demonstrate the necessity of expanding active genomic surveillance in areas at the fringe of CHIKV endemic transmission for timely detecting and characterizing emerging epidemics.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the 2025 chikungunya outbreak in southern China, which resulted in over 25,000 confirmed cases. The research aimed to reconstruct the origins and transmission dynamics of the outbreak using genomic, epidemiological, entomological, and human mobility data. The study generated 1,264 near-complete chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomes from Guangdong Province and traced the outbreak to a single introduction of a Reunion-associated East/Central/South African (ECSA) lineage. papers.title_zh: 基因组流行病学重建了中国广东省前期检测传播及基孔肯雅病毒的建立
papers.source_body_en: In 2025, a chikungunya outbreak in southern China resulted in more than 25,000 confirmed cases, but its origins and transmission history remain unresolved. As part of the public health investigation, we generated 1,264 near-complete chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomes from Guangdong Province and integrated genomic, epidemiological, entomological, and human mobility data to reconstruct the emergence and spread of this outbreak. Our analyses traced the outbreak to a single dominant introduction of a Reunion-associated East/Central/South African (ECSA) virus lineage and dated the origin of the sampled Guangdong outbreak lineage from late April to early May 2025. The interval between the estimated origin of the outbreak lineage and the first reported case was consistent with a period of undetected local transmission and exposed limitations in passive surveillance for early arboviral outbreak detection. Spatiotemporal reconstruction showed two distinct epidemic waves with contrasting transmission dynamics. The Foshan wave involved frequent medium- to long-distance viral movement, while the Jiangmen wave remained relatively localized. Together, these findings reconstruct the early establishment and spatially heterogeneous spread of the largest documented CHIKV epidemic in southern China to date and demonstrate the necessity of expanding active genomic surveillance in areas at the fringe of CHIKV endemic transmission for timely detecting and characterizing emerging epidemics.
papers.abstract_zh: 2025年,中国南部发生了一次基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)暴发,导致超过25,000例确诊病例,但其起源和传播历史仍未明确。作为公共卫生调查的一部分,我们从广东省生成了1,264个近完整的CHIKV 基因组,并整合了基因组、流行病学、媒介生物学和人类流动性数据,以重建此次暴发的出现和传播。我们的分析追踪到该暴发源于一个与留尼汪岛相关的东/中/南部非洲(ECSA)病毒谱系的单一主要引入,并将广东省所采样暴发谱系的起源时间定为2025年4月下旬至5月上旬。估计该暴发谱系起源与首例报告病例之间的时间间隔,与未被检测到的本地传播时期一致,并揭示了被动监测在早期虫媒病毒暴发检测中的局限性。时空重建显示了两个具有不同传播动态的独立流行波。佛山波涉及频繁的中至长距离病毒传播,而江门波则相对局部化。这些发现共同重建了迄今为止中国南部记录的最大CHIKV暴发的早期建立和空间异质性传播,并展示了在CHIKV流行区域边缘地区扩大主动基因组监测监测的必要性,以及时检测和表征新兴疫情。

papers.title: Nanopore Sequencing for Chikungunya Virus: Principles and Application.
papers.abstract: Nanopore sequencing is transforming viral genomics through real-time, portable, long-read analysis of RNA and DNA. Unlike traditional short-read platforms, it detects nucleotide sequences by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling direct single-molecule sequencing and base modification detection. Its simplicity, flexibility, and capacity for ultra-long reads make it ideal for resolving complex genomic regions, structural variants, and full viral genomes. These advantages have accelerated its use in pathogen surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. For chikungunya virus (CHIKV), nanopore sequencing allows rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete genomes from clinical and vector samples, enabling real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread. Experiences from Ebola, Zika, and COVID-19 have demonstrated the power of portable sequencing, now applied to CHIKV monitoring. Advances in tools such as Guppy, Dorado, Minimap2, and Medaka enhance read quality, consensus accuracy, and downstream analyses. Despite challenges in basecalling and error correction, robust quality control pipelines ensure reliable results. Ongoing improvements in chemistry, flow cell design, and machine learning will further enhance fidelity and throughput, establishing nanopore sequencing as a cornerstone of CHIKV genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the principles and application of nanopore sequencing for Chikungunya virus, examining its use in clinical and vector samples to recover complete genomes and monitor viral spread.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the application of nanopore sequencing in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomics, emphasizing its advantages in real-time, portable, and long-read analysis. The research highlights how nanopore sequencing enables rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from clinical and vector samples, facilitating real-time tracking of viral diversity and spread. The authors interpret these findings as a significant advancement in pathogen surveillance, particularly for resource-limited settings, where the method offers flexibility and power. The study notes challenges in basecalling and error correction but underscores the reliability of quality control pipelines. These results have implications for improving genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness for CHIKV. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the acknowledged limitations in the sequencing process, though the method's potential is well-supported by prior experiences with other pathogens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨纳米孔测序在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)基因组学中的应用,以应对在疫情期间快速、便携和准确追踪病毒多样性及传播的迫切需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于纳米孔测序在基孔肯雅病毒中的原理与应用,考察其在临床和环境样本中用于恢复完整病毒基因组和监测病毒传播的使用情况。
elements_zh.methods: 纳米孔测序通过测量核酸穿过纳米级孔时的离子电流变化,直接对RNA和DNA进行测序,从而实现对基孔肯雅病毒基因组的实时、单分子分析,无需依赖培养。
elements_zh.main_results: 该方法展示了从临床和环境样本中快速恢复完整病毒基因组的能力,有助于在疫情期间实时追踪病毒多样性、传播及扩散。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为病原体监测领域的重要进展,特别是在资源有限的环境中,纳米孔测序提供了一种灵活且强大的工具,用于基孔肯雅病毒的监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基孔肯雅病毒的更有效监测策略的制定提供依据,从而增强疫情响应和疫情应对能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认在碱基调用和错误校正方面存在挑战,但强调了稳健的质量控制流程,确保了可靠的结果,支持了中等程度的证据可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 纳米孔测序通过对 RNA 和 DNA 进行实时、便携式、长读长分析,正在改变病毒基因组学。与传统的短读长平台不同,它通过测量核酸通过纳米级孔时离子电流的变化来检测核苷酸序列,从而实现直接单分子测序和碱基修饰检测。其简单性、灵活性和超长读取能力使其成为解析复杂基因组区域、结构变异和完整病毒 基因组 的理想选择。这些优点加速了其在病原体 监测 和 暴发 响应中的使用,特别是在资源有限的环境中。对于 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV),纳米孔测序可以从临床和 媒介 样本中快速、独立于培养物恢复完整的 基因组,从而实现病毒多样性、进化 和传播的实时跟踪。埃博拉、寨卡和 COVID-19 的经验证明了便携式测序的强大功能,现已应用于 CHIKV 监测。Guppy、Dorado、Minimap2 和 Medaka 等工具的进步提高了读取质量、共识准确性和下游分析。尽管碱基识别和纠错方面存在挑战,但强大的质量控制流程可确保可靠的结果。化学、流动池设计和机器学习方面的持续改进将进一步提高保真度和通量,将纳米孔测序确立为 CHIKV 基因组监测 和流行病防范的基石。

papers.title: Overview of Chikungunya Virus Epidemiology, Biology, and Pathogenesis.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems. CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) epidemiology, biology, and pathogenesis. It describes the virus as an arthropod-borne alphavirus transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, causing acute febrile illness with severe polyarthralgia and potential chronic complications. The virus has a spherical, enveloped virion with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry and a positive-sense RNA genome encoding replication and structural proteins. CHIKV replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving genomic and subgenomic RNA synthesis, glycoprotein maturation, and budding at the plasma membrane. Since its introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence has remained high, with over 180,000 confirmed cases in 2025. The study highlights the expansion of CHIKV beyond Africa and Asia, driven by adaptive mutations that enhance transmission. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination, with VLP-based vaccines showing promise and live-attenuated formulations facing safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist, and current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development. The evidence is general and does not include specific limitations or evidence strength assessments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究概述了基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的结构、生物学及系统发育。研究内容包括病毒的结构、复制机制及其全球传播情况。分析涵盖了CHIKV谱系及其相关疾病。
elements_zh.methods: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。
elements_zh.main_results: 自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告局限性或证据强度。

Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.

papers.title: Protocol for Detecting and Sequencing Chikungunya Virus from Field-Collected Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒疾病是公共卫生领域的重要挑战,尤其是在热带地区,环境条件可能有利于蚊虫媒介的繁殖和传播。因此,对蚊虫种群中基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)进行早期和准确的检测,可以成为有效监测流行变异株和识别新病毒引入的宝贵工具。鉴于在野外捕获的蚊虫中检测蚊媒病毒的挑战,我们描述了一种集成的工作流程,用于CHIKV的分子检测和全基因组测序。该方案包括使用基于珠子的机械破碎仪对蚊虫进行匀浆,使用TRIzol试剂进行RNA提取(略有修改),使用CHIKV特异性RT-qPCR进行分子筛选,以及全基因组扩增后在Illumina平台上进行测序。尽管该方案针对单个蚊虫进行了优化,但仍能获得高质量的RNA,适用于虫媒监测和基因组分析。由于该方案能够从蚊虫样本中回收完整的CHIKV 基因组,因此可以作为基因组流行病学研究的基础,实现对病毒多样性及谱系动态的监测,并有助于早期发现新兴变异株,从而支持在流行和高风险地区及时、有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。

papers.title: Assessing the Vector Competence for Chikungunya Virus in Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种人类致病性蚊媒病毒(虫媒病毒),正在非洲、亚洲、欧洲、南美洲和中美洲(包括加勒比地区)人群中引起 暴发 流行。在现场开发预防蚊子 传播 病毒的新方法需要在实验室中详细研究 CHIKV 与其蚊子 媒介 的相互作用。在本章中,我们将介绍如何让埃及伊蚊做好感染新鲜培养的 CHIKV 的准备。我们还描述了基于噬菌斑测定和细胞培养中唾液样本扩增的蚊子的定量和定性病毒检测测定。

papers.title: Workflow for Long-Read Amplicon Sequencing of Chikungunya Virus Using Oxford Nanopore Technology.
papers.abstract: This protocol provides a comprehensive, step-by-step workflow for whole-genome sequencing of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) using an amplicon-based strategy optimized for Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platforms. The procedure includes detailed instructions for sample handling, viral RNA extraction, quality control, cDNA synthesis, multiplex PCR amplification, library preparation, sequencing, and primary bioinformatic processing. The protocol is designed to maximize reproducibility across laboratories and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications, including outbreak investigation and molecular epidemiology, even when working with low-to-moderate viral loads.

papers.title: Optimized Amplicon Strategy for Long-Read Sequencing of the Chikungunya Virus Genome.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title: Stepwise assembly and mechanical stability of nsP3 Helical Scaffolds in Chikungunya Virus
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense, single-stranded RNA virus that replicates its genome through a viral replication complex (RC) essential for successful infection. The RC consists of four non-structural proteins: nsP1, nsP2, nsP3, and nsP4. In this study, we focused on nsP3, which comprises three distinct domains: the alphavirus unique domain (AUD), the long and intrinsically disordered hypervariable domain (HVD), and the enzymatic macrodomain (MD). Notably, nsP3 assembles into helicoidal macrostructures, termed helical scaffolds (HSs), which are components of the CHIKV replication complex and are involved in the formation of macromolecular traps in the cytoplasm of the infected cell called Alphagranules (AGs). HSs form tubular helical scaffolds assembled through the AUD, with the MD and HVD flexibly deployed to the scaffold exterior. Despite their functional importance, the mechanisms governing HS formation remain poorly understood. Using High-Speed Atomic Force Microscopy (HS-AFM) and Electron Microscopy (EM) we achieved new findings on the structure, mechanics and assembly of these macrostructures. Our results show the nsP3 monomers follow intermediate steps before completing the assembly into full helical scaffolds, with each nsP3 domain contributing differently to this process. The macrodomain (MD) provides mechanical stability, yet it fractures under tens of piconewtons of force. This rigidity acts as a mechanical regulator that constrains the position of the HVD, which in turn mediates interactions with host factors and neighboring HSs. Through this interplay, nsP3 achieves both structural cohesion and functional adaptability, promoting the higher-order organization of HSs into honeycomb-like networks.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the structural and functional organization of the CHIKV replication complex, which could inform future studies on viral replication mechanisms and potentially contribute to the development of antiviral strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the stepwise assembly and mechanical stability of nsP3 helical scaffolds in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV). The research focuses on the structural and functional roles of nsP3 domains, particularly the alphavirus unique domain (AUD), hypervariable domain (HVD), and macrodomain (MD), in forming helical scaffolds that are essential for the replication complex. Using High-Speed Atomic Force Microscopy (HS-AFM) and Electron Microscopy (EM), the study reveals that nsP3 monomers undergo intermediate steps before assembling into full helical scaffolds. The macrodomain (MD) provides mechanical stability but fractures under tens of piconewtons of force, acting as a regulator that constrains the HVD's position. This interplay allows nsP3 to achieve structural cohesion and functional adaptability, promoting the organization of helical scaffolds into honeycomb-like networks. The findings contribute to understanding the replication mechanisms of CHIKV and may inform future antiviral strategies. The evidence is considered high due to the use of advanced imaging techniques and the detailed structural insights provided.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)是一种正链单链RNA病毒,通过病毒复制复合体(RC)复制其基因组,该复合体对于成功感染至关重要。关于调控螺旋支架(HSs)形成的机制,目前仍不明确,HSs是CHIKV复制复合体的组成部分,并参与形成感染细胞胞质中的大分子陷阱,称为α颗粒(AGs)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究重点探讨了nsP3,其包含三个不同的结构域:α病毒独特结构域(AUD)、长且内在无序的高变结构域(HVD)以及酶活性的宏结构域(MD)。RC由四个非结构蛋白组成:nsP1、nsP2、nsP3和nsP4。
elements_zh.methods: 通过高速原子力显微镜(HS-AFM)和电子显微镜(EM),本研究获得了关于这些宏结构的结构、力学和组装的新发现。nsP3单体在完成组装为完整的螺旋支架之前,会经历中间步骤,每个nsP3结构域对该过程的贡献各不相同。
elements_zh.main_results: 宏结构域(MD)提供了机械稳定性,但在数十皮牛的力作用下会发生断裂。

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中nsP3螺旋支架的逐步组装及其机械稳定性
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense, single-stranded RNA virus that replicates its genome through a viral replication complex (RC) essential for successful infection. The RC consists of four non-structural proteins: nsP1, nsP2, nsP3, and nsP4. In this study, we focused on nsP3, which comprises three distinct domains: the alphavirus unique domain (AUD), the long and intrinsically disordered hypervariable domain (HVD), and the enzymatic macrodomain (MD). Notably, nsP3 assembles into helicoidal macrostructures, termed helical scaffolds (HSs), which are components of the CHIKV replication complex and are involved in the formation of macromolecular traps in the cytoplasm of the infected cell called Alphagranules (AGs). HSs form tubular helical scaffolds assembled through the AUD, with the MD and HVD flexibly deployed to the scaffold exterior. Despite their functional importance, the mechanisms governing HS formation remain poorly understood. Using High-Speed Atomic Force Microscopy (HS-AFM) and Electron Microscopy (EM) we achieved new findings on the structure, mechanics and assembly of these macrostructures. Our results show the nsP3 monomers follow intermediate steps before completing the assembly into full helical scaffolds, with each nsP3 domain contributing differently to this process. The macrodomain (MD) provides mechanical stability, yet it fractures under tens of piconewtons of force. This rigidity acts as a mechanical regulator that constrains the position of the HVD, which in turn mediates interactions with host factors and neighboring HSs. Through this interplay, nsP3 achieves both structural cohesion and functional adaptability, promoting the higher-order organization of HSs into honeycomb-like networks.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)是一种正链单链RNA病毒,通过病毒复制复合体(RC)复制其基因组,该复合体对于成功感染至关重要。RC由四个非结构蛋白组成:nsP1、nsP2、nsP3和nsP4。本研究重点探讨了nsP3,其包含三个不同的结构域:α病毒独特结构域(AUD)、长且内在无序的高变结构域(HVD)以及酶活性的宏结构域(MD)。值得注意的是,nsP3会组装成螺旋状的宏结构,称为螺旋支架(HSs),这些结构是CHIKV复制复合体的组成部分,并参与形成感染细胞胞质中的大分子陷阱,称为α颗粒(AGs)。HSs通过AUD形成管状螺旋支架,而MD和HVD则灵活地分布在支架的外部。尽管它们在功能上具有重要意义,但调控HS形成的机制仍不明确。通过高速原子力显微镜(HS-AFM)和电子显微镜(EM),本研究获得了关于这些宏结构的结构、力学和组装的新发现。研究结果表明,nsP3单体在完成组装为完整的螺旋支架之前,会经历中间步骤,每个nsP3结构域对该过程的贡献各不相同。宏结构域(MD)提供了机械稳定性,但在数十皮牛的力作用下会发生断裂。这种刚性作用作为机械调节因子,限制了HVD的位置,而HVD则介导与宿主因子及相邻HSs的相互作用。通过这种相互作用,nsP3实现了结构的紧密性和功能的适应性,促进了HSs向类似蜂窝的网络结构的高阶组织。

papers.title: Chikungunya virus: from global emergence to immunopathology and therapeutic frontiers
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), a re-emerging mosquito-borne alphavirus, has transitioned from an endemic pathogen to a global public health threat. In May 2026, the World Health Organization’s second rapid risk assessment classified the global public health risk of CHIKV transmission as moderate. Although two vaccines (IXCHIQ ® and VIMKUNYA ® ) have been authorized in selected countries, no antiviral therapy has been approved, and supportive care remains the mainstay of clinical management. We synthesize current knowledge of CHIKV epidemiology, replication, host immune signaling, and immune evasion, together with the developmental landscape of vaccines and antivirals. Through a critical appraisal of available evidence, we propose a hierarchical evidence-weighting framework that distinguishes in vivo mechanistic findings, cell-line observations, and human validation, and we highlight the stage-dependent functions of cytokines. Finally, we outline unresolved questions in chronicity, antiviral development, next-generation vaccine design and optimization, and cross-regional public health coordination, with particular emphasis on bridging the evidence gap between animal models and human infection.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a comprehensive review of current knowledge on CHIKV, including its epidemiology, replication, host immune signaling, and immune evasion. It also covers the developmental landscape of vaccines and antivirals. The research was conducted in May 2026, and the population includes all recognized CHIKV lineages and related entities.
analysis.methods: The study synthesized current knowledge through a critical appraisal of available evidence, proposing a hierarchical evidence-weighting framework that distinguishes in vivo mechanistic findings, cell-line observations, and human validation. analysis.main_results: The study identified that although two vaccines (IXCHIQ ® and VIMKUNYA ® ) have been authorized in selected countries, no antiviral therapy has been approved, and supportive care remains the mainstay of clinical management.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the need for further research into antiviral development, next-generation vaccine design, and cross-regional public health coordination. They proposed a framework to evaluate evidence based on its source and strength.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of antiviral therapies and next-generation vaccines, as well as improve cross-regional public health coordination to address the global threat posed by CHIKV.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a review and does not include original data, which limits its ability to provide definitive conclusions. The evidence is classified as moderate due to the reliance on existing literature and the lack of new experimental findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of the global emergence and public health threat posed by Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), emphasizing the transition from an endemic pathogen to a widespread concern. It highlights the current state of vaccine development and the absence of approved antiviral therapies, with supportive care remaining the primary treatment. The authors propose a framework to evaluate evidence based on its source and strength, distinguishing between in vivo findings, cell-line observations, and human validation. They also emphasize the need for further research into antiviral development, vaccine optimization, and public health coordination. The study identifies unresolved questions in chronicity, immune mechanisms, and the gap between animal models and human infection. The evidence is classified as moderate due to the reliance on existing literature and the lack of original data, which limits the confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)是一种重新出现的蚊媒α病毒,已从一种地方性病原体转变为全球公共卫生威胁。本研究旨在填补关于CHIKV的流行病学、免疫机制和治疗开发方面的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对CHIKV现有知识的全面综述,包括其流行病学、复制、宿主免疫信号传导以及免疫逃逸。此外,还涵盖了疫苗和抗病毒药物的发展现状。研究于2026年5月进行,研究对象包括所有被认可的CHIKV谱系及相关实体。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究通过批判性评估现有证据,综合了关于CHIKV的现有知识,并提出了一种分层证据加权框架,以区分体内机制研究、细胞系观察和人类验证。同时,还强调了细胞因子的阶段依赖性功能。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究指出,尽管两种疫苗(IXCHIQ ® 和 VIMKUNYA ®)已在部分国家获得批准,但目前尚无抗病毒药物疗法获批,支持性护理仍是临床管理的主要手段。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为强调需要进一步研究抗病毒药物的发展、下一代疫苗的设计以及跨区域公共卫生协调。他们提出了一种基于证据来源和强度的评估框架。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为抗病毒药物疗法和下一代疫苗的开发提供信息,并有助于改善跨区域公共卫生协调,以应对CHIKV带来的全球威胁。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是一项综述,不包含原始数据,这限制了其提供确定性结论的能力。由于依赖现有文献且缺乏新的实验发现,证据被归类为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)是一种重新出现的蚊媒α病毒,已从一种地方性病原体转变为全球公共卫生威胁。2026年5月,世界卫生组织发布的第二份快速风险评估将CHIKV 传播的全球公共卫生风险归类为中等。尽管两种疫苗(IXCHIQ ® 和 VIMKUNYA ®)已在部分国家获得批准,但目前尚无抗病毒药物疗法获批,支持性护理仍是临床管理的主要手段。我们综合了关于CHIKV 流行病学、复制、宿主免疫信号传导以及免疫逃逸的现有知识,同时涵盖了疫苗和抗病毒药物的发展现状。通过批判性评估现有证据,我们提出了一种分层证据加权框架,以区分体内机制研究、细胞系观察和人类验证,并强调了细胞因子的阶段依赖性功能。最后,我们概述了关于慢性化、抗病毒药物发展、下一代疫苗设计与优化以及跨区域公共卫生协调的未解问题,特别强调了在动物模型与人类感染之间弥合证据差距的重要性。

papers.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance-Based Analysis of Ligand Binding Kinetics in Chikungunya Virus Drug Discovery.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging arbovirus lacking widely effective antiviral therapies, highlighting the need to characterize molecular interactions essential for its replication and pathogenesis. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is a sensitive, label-free technique that enables real-time analysis of biomolecular interactions by detecting refractive index changes at a sensor surface. SPR provides precise kinetic and affinity measurements for protein-protein, protein-RNA, and protein-ligand interactions using minimal sample quantities and supporting high-throughput screening. In CHIKV research, it has been applied to evaluate antiviral compounds, antibodies, receptor binding, and viral protein complexes. This chapter outlines key methodological considerations, including ligand preparation, immobilization strategies, assay optimization, and kinetic analysis.

papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging arbovirus lacking widely effective antiviral therapies, highlighting the need to characterize molecular interactions essential for its replication and pathogenesis. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is a sensitive, label-free technique that enables real-time analysis of biomolecular interactions by detecting refractive index changes at a sensor surface. SPR provides precise kinetic and affinity measurements for protein-protein, protein-RNA, and protein-ligand interactions using minimal sample quantities and supporting high-throughput screening. In CHIKV research, it has been applied to evaluate antiviral compounds, antibodies, receptor binding, and viral protein complexes. This chapter outlines key methodological considerations, including ligand preparation, immobilization strategies, assay optimization, and kinetic analysis.

papers.title: RT-RPA-Assisted CRISPR/Cas12a-Based Isothermal Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted through the bite of Aedes mosquitoes, specifically A. CHIKV belongs to the alphavirus with a positive-sense ssRNA genome of 11-12 kb size. The virus has been reported from various geographical regions across the globe. Chikungunya fever is an acute febrile illness, which, if left untreated, may develop into chronic arthralgia that may persist for several months or acute encephalitis syndrome. Therefore, early diagnosis of CHIKV is crucial to initiate prompt supportive treatment. Laboratory diagnosis of CHIKV typically relies on serological tests such as IgM antigen capture ELISA and molecular methods including RT-PCR or qRT-PCR. However, both these methods are not viable in peripheral settings. This chapter highlights recent advancements in molecular detection techniques for CHIKV, specifically isothermal detection methods that eliminate the requirement for complex instruments. The detection is facilitated by RT-RPA and CRISPR/Cas12a endonuclease. The assay offers advantages over existing methods such as rapid and early detection, and eliminates cross-over contamination, ultra-sensitivity, high specificity, and ease of result interpretation.

papers.title: Production of Viral Particles from a Chikungunya Virus Infectious Clone.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus, which poses challenges for its study and genetic manipulation. Because direct mutagenesis of viral RNA genomes is technically impractical, reverse genetics systems are essential tools for investigating viral biology. To enable such approaches, infectious clones containing a full-length cDNA copy of the viral genome are constructed. The cDNA is positioned under the control of a bacteriophage RNA polymerase promoter, allowing commercial RNA polymerases to use the linearized plasmid as a template for the in vitro transcription of full-length viral genomic RNA (gRNA). Importantly, positive-sense viral genomes serve as mRNAs for the translation of viral proteins in a cellular environment, meaning that these transcripts contain all the information required to initiate viral replication. Following transfection into permissive cultured cells, viral proteins are expressed, enabling genome replication and, ultimately, the recovery of infectious particles from the cell supernatant. Here, we describe a detailed procedure for generating CHIKV particles through plasmid linearization, in vitro transcription, and subsequent RNA transfection.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a detailed procedure for generating infectious Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) particles using reverse genetics. The research addresses the challenges of studying and manipulating CHIKV, which is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus. The method involves constructing infectious clones with full-length cDNA, positioning them under a bacteriophage RNA polymerase promoter, and using commercial RNA polymerases for in vitro transcription. Following transfection into permissive cultured cells, viral proteins are expressed, leading to genome replication and the recovery of infectious particles from the cell supernatant. The procedure is significant for advancing research on CHIKV biology and potential therapeutic strategies. The study does not report limitations or evidence strength, but it provides a foundational method for generating infectious viral particles.

papers.title: Naked-Eye Visual Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Method for the Rapid Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) represents a significant global health threat due to its recent resurgence. This protocol highlights the use of capillary-modified visual loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) technology for the rapid detection of CHIKV. We employed Vero cells for virus propagation and utilized the MolPure Viral DNA/RNA Kit for nucleic acid extraction, successfully amplifying extracted viral RNA at 63°C for 25 min. The presence of CHIKV was indicated by a distinct yellowish-green color change, demonstrating the effectiveness and simplicity of this protocol. Our protocol underscores the potential of LAMP technology as a rapid diagnostic tool for CHIKV, enabling timely public health interventions.

analysis.summary_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) poses a growing global health threat, prompting the development of a rapid detection method. Researchers established an in vitro protocol using Vero cells to propagate CHIKV, extracted viral RNA with the MolPure kit, and performed loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) at 63 °C for 25 minutes. Detection relied on a distinct yellowish-green color change, confirming CHIKV presence and demonstrating the assay’s simplicity and effectiveness. The authors interpret this as a promising rapid diagnostic tool that could enable timely public health interventions. By offering a point-of-care, visual LAMP assay, the protocol has the potential to enhance CHIKV surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. No limitations or evidence strength assessments were reported in the abstract.

papers.abstract: We adapted the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to detect chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates instead of serum. This approach enables serological investigation using tissues collected from animal carcasses as nonhuman primate ones, during arbovirus surveillance, expanding opportunities for CHIKV monitoring and strengthening epidemiological surveillance efforts.

papers.title: In Silico Drug Design of Chikungunya Antivirals: Using Consensus Methods for Virtual Screening.
papers.abstract: Structure-based virtual screening is an attractive strategy in drug design. It enables the selection of potential binders to target biomolecules with known molecular structures, providing a rational framework for studying their mechanisms of action and guiding further optimization. However, accurately predicting the free energy of binding remains an extremely challenging task, and the available tools only provide approximate estimates. In this context, one strategy to improve the predictive power of virtual screening and increase the probability of identifying true binders is to employ multiple docking algorithms and combine their results using a consensus method. In this chapter, we will describe a step-by-step methodology to perform this task. We will conduct a virtual screening using AutoDock Vina, AutoDock4, and LeDock, and then combine their results employing the Exponential Consensus Ranking algorithm. Finally, we will discuss possible extensions of this strategy, such as incorporating Molecular Dynamics simulations as an additional filter in the virtual screening or integrating the novel Artificial Intelligence-based methodologies into the consensus framework.

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅热 抗病毒药物 的计算机药物设计:使用共识方法进行虚拟筛选。
papers.source_body_en: Structure-based virtual screening is an attractive strategy in drug design. It enables the selection of potential binders to target biomolecules with known molecular structures, providing a rational framework for studying their mechanisms of action and guiding further optimization. However, accurately predicting the free energy of binding remains an extremely challenging task, and the available tools only provide approximate estimates. In this context, one strategy to improve the predictive power of virtual screening and increase the probability of identifying true binders is to employ multiple docking algorithms and combine their results using a consensus method. In this chapter, we will describe a step-by-step methodology to perform this task. We will conduct a virtual screening using AutoDock Vina, AutoDock4, and LeDock, and then combine their results employing the Exponential Consensus Ranking algorithm. Finally, we will discuss possible extensions of this strategy, such as incorporating Molecular Dynamics simulations as an additional filter in the virtual screening or integrating the novel Artificial Intelligence-based methodologies into the consensus framework.

papers.title: Expression and Purification of nsP2 Protease of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: The nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2) of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an essential cysteine protease involved in viral polyprotein processing and replication complex regulation. Biochemical and structural studies of nsP2 require the availability of highly pure and enzymatically active protein. In this chapter, we describe a straightforward protocol for the heterologous expression and purification of CHIKV nsP2 protease domain (nsP2pro) in Escherichia coli. The protein is expressed at low temperature as a His-tagged construct and purified under native conditions by immobilized metal ion affinity chromatography, followed by dialysis for buffer exchange. The procedure typically yields milligram quantities of highly pure (>95%) and active nsP2pro, and has been successfully applied to wild-type and mutant variants for enzymatic assays and inhibitor screening.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了在大肠杆菌中异源表达和纯化 CHIKV nsP2 蛋白酶结构域的方案,重点是蛋白质的生产和分离。
analysis_zh.methods: nsP2 蛋白酶结构域在低温下表达为 His 标记构建体,并在天然条件下使用固定化金属离子亲和层析进行纯化,然后进行透析以进行缓冲液交换。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该程序通常会产生毫克量的高纯度 (>95%) 和活性 nsP2pro,并已成功应用于野生型和突变体的酶测定和抑制剂筛选。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所述方法为获得活性 nsP2pro 提供了一种可靠且直接的方法,这对于进一步的生化和结构研究很有价值。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持开发用于研究 CHIKV 蛋白酶功能的工具,这可能有助于 抗病毒药物 疗法和诊断的设计。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于描述方案,并未报告其在临床或流行病学背景下的应用,这限制了其与公共卫生的直接相关性。

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus Infection in Paraffin-Embedded Tissue: Analysis of Histological Alterations and Viral Detection by Immunohistochemistry.
papers.abstract: Histopathological analysis of tissues infected with Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), including biopsy and autopsy specimens, can provide valuable insights into the pathogenesis of atypical and fatal cases. By examining tissue architecture and cellular alterations under the microscope, it is possible to identify patterns of injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration. These morphological findings provide evidence of how the pathogen interacts with host cells and tissues. Moreover, immunohistochemistry may be performed in tissue sections for the detection of viral antigens. Importantly, this technique allows the characterization of diverse biologically relevant targets in tissue samples, such as distinct immune cell subsets, cytokines, and additional molecular markers. This is accomplished by the use of antibodies selected for their specificity toward the antigen of interest. In this chapter, we present a concise overview of how histological analysis and immunohistochemical approaches can enhance the understanding of CHIKV-associated pathological mechanisms.

elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及组织结构和细胞变化的组织学分析,以及检测病毒抗原的免疫组织化学。这些技术用于表征生物相关目标,例如组织样本中的免疫细胞亚群、细胞因子和分子标记。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究观察到了受感染组织中 CHIKV 诱导的损伤、炎症和细胞变性的组织学改变。免疫组织化学证实这些样本中存在病毒抗原。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了组织学和免疫组织化学方法在阐明 CHIKV 感染病理机制方面的实用性。这为病毒与 宿主 组织的相互作用提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可以为改进的诊断方法提供信息并增强对 CHIKV 发病机制 的理解,这对于开发有针对性的 监测 和 治疗 策略至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的描述,不提供详细的统计或实验数据。由于缺乏具体的数值研究结果和综合分析,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Assessing Chikungunya Virus Protease Activity and Pharmacological Inhibition Using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp Fluorogenic Peptide Substrate.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus, a mosquito-borne alphavirus, poses a significant global health threat due to its rapid spread and lack of approved antiviral therapies. The viral nonstructural protein 2 protease (nsP2p) plays a critical role in processing the viral polyprotein to produce key viral enzymes, making it an attractive target for drug development. In this study, we describe the expression and purification of recombinant CHIKV nsP2 protease and establish a robust fluorogenic assay to measure its enzymatic activity using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp peptide substrate. The assay enables real-time monitoring of proteolytic cleavage and provides a platform for evaluating small-molecule inhibitors. We present optimized conditions for protein expression in E. coli, affinity purification, and tag removal, achieving high-purity nsP2 protease suitable for biochemical characterization. Using this system, we also provide a robust protocol for determining IC50 values for candidate inhibitors. This work provides a reproducible methodology for high-throughput screening of CHIKV protease inhibitors, facilitating the discovery of potential antiviral compounds against chikungunya virus.

source_records.abstract: Chikungunya virus, a mosquito-borne alphavirus, poses a significant global health threat due to its rapid spread and lack of approved antiviral therapies. The viral nonstructural protein 2 protease (nsP2p) plays a critical role in processing the viral polyprotein to produce key viral enzymes, making it an attractive target for drug development. This work provides a reproducible methodology for high-throughput screening of CHIKV protease inhibitors, facilitating the discovery of potential antiviral compounds against chikungunya virus.

papers.title: Quantification of Chikungunya Virus RNA by Real-Time RT-PCR Assay.
papers.abstract: RT-qPCR is characterized by‌ high sensitivity, strong specificity, excellent reproducibility, and operational simplicity, ‌enabling‌ rapid quantification of viral RNA within a short timeframe. The real-time PCR system relies upon the measurement of a fluorescent reporter during PCR, in which the amount of emitted fluorescence is directly proportional to the amount of the PCR product in a reaction. Here, we describe the use of TaqMan® probe-based one-tube Real-time reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) for the detection and quantification of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) RNA.

papers.title: Determination of Chikungunya Virus Infectious Titer Using Plaque Assays.
papers.abstract: The plaque-forming assay is the gold-standard method for measuring infectious viral particles. In this technique, lytic viruses infect and destroy host cells, but their spread is restricted by a viscous overlay medium. As a result, new viral particles can only infect neighboring cells, leading to localized clear areas known as plaques, which become visible after staining the remaining living cells. The number of plaques reflects the number of infectious viral particles initially present in the sample and is reported as plaque-forming units (PFU) per sample volume. In this protocol, we describe step by step how to perform a plaque-forming assay to determine the concentration of chikungunya virus in a cell culture supernatant.

papers.title: Automated Counting of Chikungunya Virus-Formed Plaques.
papers.abstract: The cytopathic effect (CPE) is a key to understanding the pathogenicity of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and is useful for evaluating viral infectivity in vitro. The plaque assay, based on the CPE induced by viral infection, provides an infectious virus titer for test samples. Additionally, the assay is simple, quantitative, and cost-effective. Thus, the plaque assay remains the gold standard for determining the infectivity of CHIKV. However, manually counting of virus-induced plaques with the naked eye or under the microscope is often time-consuming and labor-intensive. Therefore, automated plaque-counting software would improve the consistency and efficiency of plaque counting. We recently developed plaQuest, a stand-alone Windows software that enables rapid, reliable plaque counting for CHIKV. In this chapter, we describe the basic procedure for detecting and counting the CHIKV-formed plaques in a 24-well plate.

papers.title: Dengue, Chikungunya and West Nile Virus in North Africa: Documented Transmission and Limits of Detection
papers.abstract: Evidence on dengue, chikungunya and West Nile virus (WNV) in North Africa has been synthesised one virus at a time or at continental scale. This narrative review with a structured search brings all three together for Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt and Sudan, and asks whether few reported cases reflect under-detection or low transmission. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched from 1940 to 3 October 2026, with WHO reports and citation chaining; each source was assigned one of five evidence levels and claims worded to match. WNV transmission is documented in Egypt, where the virus was isolated from human sera in 1951, and in Algeria, Tunisia, Morocco and Libya, with recurrent neuroinvasive outbreaks in Tunisia (1997–2023) and Algeria (1994). The reported excess of North African seroprevalence over Southern Europe (15.4% against 2.7%) rests largely on assays without neutralization confirmation; where both were measured, confirmed values were lower (6.7% against 9.8% in Algiers; 10% against 25% in Tunisian horses in 2023). Dengue and chikungunya transmission is documented in Sudan, including all four dengue serotypes in Kassala in 2023–24, and in Egypt, in Upper Egypt and on the Red Sea and Sinai coasts. Neither has been reported as locally acquired in the Maghreb or Libya, although Aedes albopictus has been present there for 8 to 16 years and transmits chikungunya virus in the laboratory. Reported case counts cannot distinguish low transmission from non-detection. The study most needed is a neutralization-confirmed serosurvey of these two viruses in resident Maghreb populations.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and its associated disease, chikungunya fever, in North Africa. It examines whether the low number of reported cases reflects under-detection or truly low transmission rates. The study includes Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, and Sudan, and addresses the presence of CHIKV and its lineages in these regions.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a structured search using PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Google Scholar from 1940 to 3 October 2026. It incorporated WHO reports and citation chaining. Each source was assigned one of five evidence levels, and claims were worded to match these levels. The review is a narrative synthesis rather than a meta-analysis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Chikungunya virus transmission is documented in Sudan, including all four dengue serotypes in Kassala in 2023–24, and in Egypt, in Upper Egypt and on the Red Sea and Sinai coasts. However, no locally acquired cases of chikungunya have been reported in the Maghreb or Libya, despite the presence of Aedes albopictus there for 8 to 16 years, which can transmit the virus in laboratory settings.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The reported excess of North African seroprevalence over Southern Europe (15.4% against 2.7%) is based largely on assays without neutralization confirmation. Where both assays were measured, confirmed values were lower (6.7% against 9.8% in Algiers; 10% against 25% in Tunisian horses in 2023). analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The study most needed is a neutralization-confirmed serosurvey of Chikungunya virus in resident Maghreb populations to better understand transmission dynamics and address the current evidence gaps.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes evidence on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in North Africa, focusing on transmission and detection. It highlights that CHIKV is documented in Sudan and Egypt, but no locally acquired cases have been reported in the Maghreb or Libya, despite the presence of Aedes albopictus. The review notes that seroprevalence data may be inflated due to assays lacking neutralization confirmation. It emphasizes the need for neutralization-confirmed serosurveys in the Maghreb to clarify transmission patterns and address gaps in detection methods.

papers.abstract_zh: 关于北非登革热、基孔肯雅热和西尼罗病毒(WNV)的证据是分别针对每种病毒或在大陆范围内进行的。本叙述性综述通过结构化搜索将这三种病毒整合在一起,涵盖摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚、突尼斯、利比亚、埃及和苏丹,并探讨报告的病例数量较少是否反映了检测不足或传播的真实水平较低。搜索范围包括PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Google Scholar,时间跨度为1940年至2026年10月3日,结合了世界卫生组织报告和文献引用链;每个来源被分配为五个证据等级之一,并根据这些等级进行表述。WNV的传播在埃及有记录,该病毒于1951年从人类血清中分离出来,并在阿尔及利亚、突尼斯、摩洛哥和利比亚有记录,其中突尼斯(1997–2023)和阿尔及利亚(1994)均报告了反复发生的神经侵袭性暴发。北非血清流行率的报告数量高于南欧(15.4% vs 2.7%)主要基于未进行中和确认的检测方法;在两者均被测量的情况下,确认的数值较低(阿尔及尔为6.7% vs 9.8%;2023年突尼斯马群为10% vs 25%)。登革热和基孔肯雅热的传播在苏丹有记录,包括2023–24年卡萨拉地区所有四种登革热血清型,以及在埃及上埃及和红海及西奈海岸地区有记录。尽管在北非地区(包括马格里布地区和利比亚)已有8至16年的Aedes albopictus存在,并且在实验室环境中可传播基孔肯雅病毒,但尚未报告这两种病毒的本地感染病例。报告的病例数量无法区分低传播与未检测到的情况,突显了重要的证据缺口。最需要进行的研究是针对这两种病毒在马格里布地区居民中的血清学调查,并通过中和确认来更好地理解传播的动态变化,填补当前的证据缺口。

papers.title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes the epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas, focusing on the spread and burden of these diseases. The review included 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO between 2012 and 2025. Key findings indicate that dengue incidence has increased globally since 1990, with significant regional variations and a high burden in Latin America. Chikungunya expanded across the Americas since 2013, causing explosive urban outbreaks and persistent joint manifestations. Urbanization, the spread of Aedes species, and insecticide resistance are identified as factors that facilitate transmission. The review highlights the need for new vaccines and integrated vector control strategies to address the growing public health challenge posed by these arboviruses in tropical and subtropical cities.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:证明城市流行病学对登革热和基孔肯雅热的影响。方法:PubMed 和 SciELO 中的 síntesis narrativa 的修订(2012-2025);包括 15 个工作室。结果:1990 年世界登革热事件,拉丁美洲地区市场和货运方面存在差异。基孔肯雅热在 2013 年美洲地区得到扩展,并产生了城市爆炸性的产品,并具有持久的关节表现。城市化、埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的扩张以及对传播有利于杀虫剂的抵抗力。Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado。结论:虫媒病毒在热带和亚热带城市中发挥着重要作用,并在预防和控制方面发挥着重要作用。

papers.title: Evaluating Chikungunya Surveillance Reports Across Source Qualification, Model Influence, and Geographic Transfer: A Retrospective Audit Study (Preprint)
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Chikungunya notifications vary in case definition, geographic coverage, and reporting practice. A reported zero is not an absent report, and overall model scores may obscure influential outbreaks or differences in uncertainty across settings. OBJECTIVE To assess how original-source qualification, influential reports, geographic transfer, and prediction-interval performance affect the interpretation of models that reconstruct chikungunya surveilWe reviewed 547 annual candidate reports from 52 of 250 statistical units in a 2005–2025 search frame, distinguishing positive reports, explicit zeros, and missing records. Nine previously fitted models were compared on 85 reports from 47 units in 2022–2025 using unit-equal Poisson deviance. We examined unit-level influence, fixed-prediction sensitivity analyses, withholding schemes, strict unit-held-out transfer, and interval coverage, width, and scores. Post-inspection analyses did not refit the models.lance reports. METHODS We reviewed 547 annual candidate reports from 52 of 250 statistical units in a 2005–2025 search frame, distinguishing positive reports, explicit zeros, and missing records. Post-inspection analyses did not refit the models. RESULTS Source review supported 543 of 547 reports for the source-defined annual-count target, including 226 explicit zeros. The training-unit mean had lower temporal deviance than empirical Bayes (35,800.49 vs 75,242.16), but the paired difference of −39,441.67 had a 95% unit-bootstrap interval spanning zero (−113,569.18 to 1,552.40). Brazil and Cuba accounted for 101.7% of the net difference; omitting them reversed the point ranking. Under strict unit-held-out evaluation, random forest had lower deviance (77,167) than the exploratory regional selection rules (100,884–108,611). Calibrated 95% interval coverage was 77/85 (90.6%) overall and 9/16 (56.3%) in the Americas; wider intervals increased the overall interval score from 309,178 to 378,773. CONCLUSIONS Source-defined outcomes, simple baseline models, influence diagnostics, transfer-specific validation, and geographically stratified interval evaluation are necessary for interpreting retrospective surveillance model scores. These findings support auditable comparisons of documented reports, not estimation of latent infections or prospective forecasting performance.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates how variations in source qualification, model influence, and geographic transfer affect the interpretation of chikungunya surveillance model reports. It highlights the importance of accurate reporting and model evaluation for public health monitoring. The researchers reviewed 547 annual reports from 52 statistical units between 2005 and 2025, categorizing them into positive reports, explicit zeros, and missing records. They compared nine models on 85 reports from 47 units using Poisson deviance. The results showed that source review supported most reports, and Brazil and Cuba had a significant impact on model rankings. Calibrated interval coverage was 90.6% overall and 56.3% in the Americas. The findings suggest that auditable comparisons of documented reports are necessary, rather than estimating latent infections or forecasting performance. The evidence is based on abstract-only data, and the confidence in the findings is moderate.

papers.title: Arboviroses e suas manifestações musculoesqueléticas subsídios para o diagnóstico diferencial entre dengue, Chikungunya e Zika Arboviruses and their musculoskeletal manifestations: clues for the differential diagnosis of dengue, Chikungunya and Zika Arbovirus y sus manifestaciones musculoesqueléticas: claves para el diagnóstico diferencial del dengue, chikungunya y zika.
papers.abstract: Introdução: Dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, transmitidas pelo Aedes aegypti, cocirculam no Brasil e compartilham manifestações iniciais, o que dificulta o diagnóstico diferencial.Objetivo: Caracterizar o quadro clínico de dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, com ênfase nos sintomas musculoesqueléticos e constitucionais, e sistematizar elementos para o diagnóstico diferencial. Métodos: Revisão narrativa nas bases SciELO, LILACS e PubMed/MEDLINE, com publicações de 2012 a 2026, complementada por documentos do Ministério da Saúde e recomendações da Sociedade Brasileira de Reumatologia. Resultados: Na dengue, predominam febre alta por dois a sete dias, mialgia intensa e artralgia leve, com risco de extravasamento plasmático na defervescência. Na Chikungunya, mais de 90% dos pacientes apresentam poliatralgia simétrica e incapacitante, com edema e tenossinovite, e cerca de metade evolui para doença crônica, por vezes com artrite erosiva. Na Zika, a febre é baixa ou ausente, o exantema pruriginoso é precoce, a conjuntivite é frequente e a artralgia é discreta; a infecção congênita pode cursar com artrogripose. Trombocitopenia sugere dengue, e linfopenia, Chikungunya. O RT-PCR é indicado é indicado até o quinto dia e a sorologia a partir do sexto, com reação cruzada entre flavivírus. Anti-inflamatórios e corticosteroides devem ser evitados até que a dengue seja afastada. Conclusão: O padrão musculoesquelético, associado ao comportamento da febre e do exantema, orienta o diagnóstico diferencial nos primeiros dias; a cronificação da Chikungunya exige seguimento estruturado e manejo da dor conforme a fase da doença.
authors: Mateus Dornelas Mitchell Paiva de Almeida
Maria Helena Queiroz de Araújo Mariano
papers.journal: Brazilian Journal of Implantology and Health Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the clinical picture of dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika, with emphasis on musculoskeletal and constitutional symptoms, and to systematize elements for differential diagnosis. The scientific/public-health problem is the difficulty in differentiating these arboviruses due to overlapping initial symptoms.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A narrative review was conducted using SciELO, LILACS, and PubMed/MEDLINE databases from 2012 to 2026, supplemented by Ministry of Health documents and recommendations from the Brazilian Society of Rheumatology.
analysis.methods: The review included RT-PCR until the fifth day and serology from the sixth day, with cross-reactivity between flaviviruses. Anti-inflammatory and corticosteroid use was advised to be avoided until dengue was ruled out.
analysis.main_results: Chikungunya patients predominantly present with severe polyarthralgia and edema, with about half evolving to chronic disease, sometimes with erosive arthritis. Dengue is characterized by high fever lasting two to seven days, intense myalgia, and mild arthralgia, with risk of plasma extravasation during defervescence. Zika infection is associated with low or absent fever, pruriginous exanthema, frequent conjunctivitis, and discrete arthralgia; congenital infection may lead to arthrogryposis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the importance of the musculoskeletal pattern, fever behavior, and exanthema in early differential diagnosis. Chronic Chikungunya arthritis requires structured follow-up and pain management according to the disease phase.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and management of these arboviruses, particularly in the early stages of infection, where clinical manifestations are critical for differential diagnosis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the reliance on narrative review and the absence of randomized controlled trials. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize the clinical manifestations of dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika, emphasizing musculoskeletal symptoms, and to provide elements for differential diagnosis. The review highlights the importance of early clinical signs in distinguishing these arboviruses, with Chikungunya often presenting severe polyarthralgia and dengue characterized by high fever and myalgia.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过SciELO、LILACS和PubMed/MEDLINE数据库进行叙述性综述,时间范围为2012年至2026年,同时结合卫生部文件和巴西风湿病学会的建议。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒的监测、诊断和管理,特别是在感染早期,临床表现对于鉴别诊断至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于叙述性综述的依赖性,且缺乏随机对照试验。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度为中等。

papers.title: DOR CRÔNICA PÓS-CHIKUNGUNYA E SUAS REPERCUSSÕESNA SAÚDE MENTAL: UMA REVISÃO SISTEMÁTICA
papers.abstract: Objetivou-se avaliar a associação entre a dor crônica pós-chikungunya e desfechos relacionados à saúde mental, comênfase nos distúrbios da qualidade do sono. A revisão foi conduzida conforme as recomendações do PRISMA 2020e registrada no PROSPERO (CRD420261382888). As buscas foram realizadas nas bases PubMed/MEDLINE,Scopus, BVS e SciELO, complementadas por busca na literatura cinzenta. Foram incluídos 11 estudos publicadosentre 2018 e 2026, totalizando 2.943 participantes, com predomínio de delineamentos transversais (54,5%), seguidospor coortes longitudinais (27,3%) e ensaios clínicos randomizados (18,2%). Os resultados demonstraram que a dorcrônica pós-chikungunya está consistentemente associada a maior prevalência de sintomas ansiosos e depressivos,comprometimento funcional e redução da qualidade de vida. A qualidade do sono destacou-se como um domínioparticularmente afetado, funcionando como determinante independente do componente físico da qualidadede vida e como possível elo entre o sofrimento físico e o psicológico, em um ciclo bidirecional envolvendo dor,sono e humor. Intervenções centradas exclusivamente no controle da dor, como a estimulação transcraniana porcorrente contínua, nem sempre promoveram melhora concomitante da qualidade do sono. A avaliação da qualidademetodológica evidenciou risco de viés moderado a sério na maioria dos estudos, com poucas exceções de alta robustezmetodológica. Conclui-se que a chikungunya crônica configura uma condição multidimensional que exige abordagemmultidisciplinar, incluindo avaliação sistemática e manejo específico da qualidade do sono, além do controle da dor eda saúde mental.
authors: Tiago Bezerra de Sá de Sousa Nogueira
papers.journal: Revista CPAQV - Centro de Pesquisas Avançadas em Qualidade de Vida

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the association between chronic post-chikungunya pain and mental health outcomes, with emphasis on sleep quality. A systematic review of 11 studies published between 2018 and 2026, involving 2,943 participants, was conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered in PROSPERO. The results showed that chronic post-chikungunya pain is consistently linked to higher prevalence of anxiety and depressive symptoms, functional impairment, and reduced quality of life. Sleep quality was highlighted as a particularly affected domain, acting as an independent determinant of physical quality of life and potentially serving as a link between physical and psychological suffering in a bidirectional cycle involving pain, sleep, and mood. The study concluded that chronic chikungunya represents a multidimensional condition requiring a multidisciplinary approach, including systematic assessment and specific management of sleep quality, alongside pain and mental health control. However, the methodological quality of most studies was rated as moderate to serious, with few exceptions showing high robustness.

papers.title: Global Genomic Surveillance.
papers.abstract: Global genomic surveillance has emerged as a foundational pillar of public health in the twenty-first century, enabling real-time tracking of pathogen evolution and informing outbreak response. This chapter examines the strategic architecture of global genomic surveillance, focusing on its application to arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV). It explores the integration of genomic data with epidemiological, clinical, and environmental information within a One Health framework, while addressing critical challenges in governance, equity, and interoperability. The discussion covers the entire genomic surveillance workflow, from sample collection and sequencing to bioinformatic analysis and phylogenetic inference, and highlights the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) in predictive surveillance. By analyzing global initiatives, operational barriers, and emerging technologies, this chapter underscores the necessity of sustainable, equitable, and interoperable genomic systems to proactively address current and future infectious disease threats.

papers.title: Etiological spectrum of acute encephalitis syndrome in children in India: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) continues to be an important cause of illness and death among children in India. While Japanese encephalitis (JE) virus has traditionally been regarded as the leading cause, recent studies indicate that the range of causative organisms has widened considerably. AIM: To estimate the pooled proportion of AES cases attributable to various common infectious etiologies among children aged 18 years or younger in India. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Scopus was conducted for studies published between January 2000 and December 2025. Studies conducted in India that included at least 25 children (≤ 18 years) with AES and reported laboratory-confirmed etiologies were considered eligible. Case reports and small case series were excluded. Quality assessment of included studies was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. A random-effects model was used to obtain pooled estimates and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). RESULTS: A total of 69 studies were included in the final analysis. Scrub typhus emerged as the most common cause, accounting for 20% (95%CI: 13%-27%) of AES cases, followed by JE at 13% (95%CI: 11%-15%). Enterovirus accounted for 6% of the cases (95%CI: 3%-9%). Dengue, herpes simplex virus and Epstein-Barr virus accounted for 5% of the cases each (95%CI: 3%-8%, 2%-9%, and 1%-11%, respectively). Mumps and chikungunya virus accounted for 4% each (95%CI: 1%-8%, and 2%-5%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Scrub typhus and JE are the leading identifiable etiology of pediatric AES in India. Broader diagnostic methods, including molecular techniques, may improve the diagnostic yield and facilitate early targeted therapy in children with AES.

papers.title_zh: 印度儿童急性脑炎综合征的病因谱:系统评价和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) continues to be an important cause of illness and death among children in India. While Japanese encephalitis (JE) virus has traditionally been regarded as the leading cause, recent studies indicate that the range of causative organisms has widened considerably. AIM: To estimate the pooled proportion of AES cases attributable to various common infectious etiologies among children aged 18 years or younger in India. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Scopus was conducted for studies published between January 2000 and December 2025. Studies conducted in India that included at least 25 children (≤ 18 years) with AES and reported laboratory-confirmed etiologies were considered eligible. Case reports and small case series were excluded. Quality assessment of included studies was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. A random-effects model was used to obtain pooled estimates and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). RESULTS: A total of 69 studies were included in the final analysis. Scrub typhus emerged as the most common cause, accounting for 20% (95%CI: 13%-27%) of AES cases, followed by JE at 13% (95%CI: 11%-15%). Enterovirus accounted for 6% of the cases (95%CI: 3%-9%). Dengue, herpes simplex virus and Epstein-Barr virus accounted for 5% of the cases each (95%CI: 3%-8%, 2%-9%, and 1%-11%, respectively). Mumps and chikungunya virus accounted for 4% each (95%CI: 1%-8%, and 2%-5%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Scrub typhus and JE are the leading identifiable etiology of pediatric AES in India. Broader diagnostic methods, including molecular techniques, may improve the diagnostic yield and facilitate early targeted therapy in children with AES.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:急性脑炎综合征(AES)仍然是印度儿童患病和死亡的重要原因。虽然日本脑炎(JE)病毒传统上被认为是主要原因,但最近的研究表明,致病微生物的范围已大大扩大。目的:估计印度 18 岁或以下儿童中由各种常见感染病因引起的 AES 病例的汇总比例。方法:对 PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE 和 Scopus 进行全面检索,查找 2000 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的研究。在印度进行的研究,包括至少 25 名患有 AES 的儿童(≤ 18 岁),并报告了实验室确认的病因,被认为是合格的。病例报告 和小箱系列被排除在外。使用乔安娜布里格斯研究所清单对纳入的研究进行质量评估。使用随机效应模型来获得汇总估计值及其相应的 95% 置信区间 (CI)。结果:共有69项研究纳入最终分析。恙虫病是最常见的病因,占 AES 病例的 20%(95%CI:13%-27%),其次是乙脑,占 13%(95%CI:11%-15%)。肠道病毒占病例的 6%(95%CI:3%-9%)。登革热、单纯疱疹病毒和 Epstein-Barr 病毒各占病例的 5%(95%CI:分别为 3%-8%、2%-9% 和 1%-11%)。腮腺炎和 基孔肯雅病毒 各占 4%(95%CI:分别为 1%-8% 和 2%-5%)。结论:恙虫病和乙型脑炎是印度儿童 AES 的主要可识别病因。更广泛的诊断方法,包括分子技术,可以提高 AES 儿童的诊断率并促进早期靶向治疗。

papers.title: Molecular Cloning and Reverse Genetics.
papers.abstract: This chapter describes a detailed molecular biology protocol for introducing specific point mutations into the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genome using a reverse genetics strategy. The method utilizes an overlapping PCR-based approach to generate a mutated DNA fragment, which is then cloned into a pre-engineered CHIKV infectious clone plasmid. The protocol covers all major steps, from the initial PCRs to create the mutated insert to its digestion and ligation into the vector. It also includes procedures for bacterial transformation, colony screening via PCR and Sanger sequencing to confirm the mutation, and plasmid purification via miniprep. The document is structured with a clear introduction, a list of all required reagents and equipment, and a step-by-step methods section.

The method utilizes an overlapping PCR-based approach to generate a mutated DNA fragment, which is then cloned into a pre-engineered CHIKV infectious clone plasmid. The protocol covers all major steps, from the initial PCRs to create the mutated insert to its digestion and ligation into the vector. It also includes procedures for bacterial transformation, colony screening via PCR and Sanger sequencing to confirm the mutation, and plasmid purification via miniprep. The document is structured with a clear introduction, a list of all required reagents and equipment, and a step-by-step methods section.

papers.title: Mosquito Surveillance in Quarantine Areas of Ports and Airports in the Chungcheong Region, Republic of Korea, 2025.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate mosquito species composition and mosquito-borne pathogens in airport and seaport quarantine areas in the Chungcheong region to support the prevention of imported vectors and mosquito-borne diseases. METHODS: Mosquitoes were collected twice monthly from March to November 2025 at nine sites in Gunsan Port, Pyeongtaek-Dangjin Port, Daesan Port, and Cheongju International Airport, using black light, Biogents-sentinel, and gravid traps, except once in March and November. Collected mosquitoes were identified and subsequently tested for flaviviruses and chikungunya virus using nucleic acid detection assays. RESULTS: A total of 8,393 mosquitoes representing nine species were collected. Culex pipiens predominated (67.3%), followed by Aedes albopictus (16.9%), Aedes vexans (4.0%), Anopheles spp. (3.4%), and Ochlerotatus koreicus (2.8%). Mosquito abundance peaked in July, with Gunsan Port accounting for 58.8% of all collections. All mosquito pools tested negative for flavivirus and chikungunya virus. CONCLUSIONS: No exotic mosquito species, including Aedes aegypti, or mosquito-borne pathogens were detected in the quarantine zones. pipiens, a potential vector of West Nile virus, and Ae. albopictus, a potential vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses, increased by 152.7% and 52.3%, respectively, compared with the previous year (2,235 and 929, respectively). Continued mosquito vector surveillance in quarantine areas can provide baseline data to support for early detection of introduced mosquito-borne disease risks and inform effective quarantine and vector control strategies.
